input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is PAINTING STYLE ONLY, never copy its person, framing or pose. Keep the same face, headwear, clothes and single set of equipment. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Older powerful man, deep brown skin and thick short greying beard, broad pale ochre hooded shoulder wrap over ivory layered cloth, stone charms and leather pouches, heavy gnarled staff with angular stone head. Floating stone motes and compact dust. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 separate complete poses of ONE SAME character. Read left to right, top to bottom. Row 1: four keys of a QUICK FLINCH AND RECOVERY: 1 ready upright pose; 2 sharp unmistakable recoil with shoulders and head pulled BACK by one head-width and torso bent back 25 degrees; 3 shoulders returning and braced bent legs; 4 upright recovered ready pose. These four poses MUST visibly differ, not four standing duplicates. Row 2: first four keys of a BIGGER STAGGER: 5 upright ready; 6 abrupt backward bend of upper body; 7 deepest backward bend, arms pulled close, balance visibly lost; 8 lower body catches the weight, bent knees or legs. Row 3: 9 pushing back upright, visibly struggling; 10 upright recovered. Then begin COLLAPSE: 11 ready upright; 12 legs buckle and body drops. Row 4: continue COLLAPSE: 13 body very low, leaning toward ground; 14 torso falls sideways nearly horizontal; 15 body settles FULLY LYING on its side, head and entire torso on ground; 16 body completely still FULLY LYING ON GROUND, legs extended or naturally folded, equipment resting beside it. The final TWO poses must be completely horizontal resting bodies, never crouching, kneeling, sitting or getting back up. Treat collapse as a harmless theatrical fall/rest pose, fully intact. No blood, gore, wounds or injury detail. No attacker, impact flash or effects. Each of the 16 equal cells contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 65% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. CORRECTION: Rear-facing all the way: back of head, back cloak and spine face camera. Collapse FORWARD AWAY, face DOWN and HIDDEN in both final lying keys. The entire body AND staff fit in middle 60% of each cell, especially the bottom row. No clipped feet or weapons. Strong 25 degree torso flinch in key 2.

arguments.Prompt:
Original hand-painted 2D digital dark fantasy game animation sprite sheet on a solid, uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows (16 equal grid cells) showing 16 sequential animation keyframes of ONE single character, read left to right, top to bottom.

Character Identity & Equipment (strictly matching Reference-1.png): Older powerful man with deep brown skin and thick short greying beard, wearing a broad pale ochre hooded shoulder wrap over ivory layered cloth, stone charms, leather pouches, and carrying a heavy gnarled staff with an angular stone head, accompanied by small floating stone motes and dust particles. Painting style strictly follows Reference-2.png: sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, silver highlights, worn edges, smooth opaque paint, cool upper-left lighting. No 3D render, no heavy black cartoon outlines.

Camera Angle & Orientation: Elevated 55-degree orthographic view. Consistent REAR-RIGHT three-quarter perspective for ALL upright and staggering frames: character's back, spine, and back of hood/head face towards the viewer, facing diagonally away to the right. Never facing front.

Grid Layout & Frames (Each cell contains the whole character scaled identically, centered within the middle 60% of each cell, leaving generous empty magenta borders, no parts clipping edges):
Row 1 (Flinch & Recovery):
- Cell 1: Upright ready stance, rear-right view.
- Cell 2: Sharp flinch recoil, torso bent back 25 degrees, head and shoulders pulled back unmistakably.
- Cell 3: Torso returning forward, knees braced and bent.
- Cell 4: Recovered upright ready stance.

Row 2 (Big Stagger):
- Cell 5: Upright ready stance.
- Cell 6: Abrupt backward bend of upper body.
- Cell 7: Deepest backward stagger, arms pulled close, balance lost.
- Cell 8: Lower body catches weight on deeply bent legs.

Row 3 (Recovery & Collapse Start):
- Cell 9: Straining upward, pushing back upright.
- Cell 10: Upright recovered stance.
- Cell 11: Upright ready stance.
- Cell 12: Legs buckle, body dropping downward.

Row 4 (Collapse & Ground Rest):
- Cell 13: Crouching very low to the ground.
- Cell 14: Torso falling forward/away nearly horizontal.
- Cell 15: Body fully lying flat on ground face-down/front-down, spine and back uppermost facing camera, face completely hidden, harmless theatrical rest.
- Cell 16: Completely still, fully horizontal lying on ground face-down, back uppermost facing camera, face completely hidden, staff resting flat beside body.

Pure solid vivid magenta #FF00FF background across entire image. No panel borders, no text, no numbers, no floor grid, no blood, no injury.
